name: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔
bio_short: 奥地利帝国生物学家、气象学家和奥古斯丁会修道士，被誉为“现代遗传学之父”。他通过著名的“豌豆杂交实验”（`mendel_genetics_1866`）发现了遗传的基本定律（分离定律和自由组合定律），尽管生前未受重视，但他奠定了现代生物学的数学基础。
bio_short_en: An Austrian biologist, meteorologist, and Augustinian friar, known as the 'Father of Modern Genetics'. Through his famous 'pea hybridization experiments' (`mendel_genetics_1866`), he discovered the fundamental laws of inheritance (segregation and independent assortment), laying the mathematical foundation for modern biology despite being ignored during his lifetime.
